objects.description: No structs, enums, typedefs, or classes are defined in this header. It only declares two functions: ual_version and ual_add. Therefore, there are no custom data types to document.

functions.name: ual_version
functions.description: Returns the UAL library version as an integer. Typical usage is to query this at startup or during capability checks to conditionally enable features. No parameters are required; the exact versioning scheme (e.g., semantic version encoding) is unknown from the header.

functions.name: ual_add
functions.description: Computes and returns the sum of two integers a and b. Useful as a simple arithmetic helper. Note: in C, signed integer overflow is undefined behavior; callers should avoid passing values whose sum would overflow the range of int if they require defined behavior.
requirements: Arguments a and b must be representable as C int values.
If defined behavior is required under standard C rules, ensure that (a + b) stays within the range of int to avoid signed overflow.
